summary: Avalanche Treasury Corporation (Nasdaq: AVAT) reported on Form 8-K that it sold 2,082,371.607744 AVAX tokens to Avalanche (BVI), Inc. in three tranches for $15,000,000 gross proceeds, closing September 23, 2026. The tokens were the company's longest-dated locked AVAX, cutting weighted average locked-token duration to roughly 16.5 months. Proceeds will reduce debt and fund general corporate purposes. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock disclosed. Watch for further treasury-token monetization, debt paydown disclosure, and AVAT trading relative to NAV-derived book value.
